findings: The supplied source-analysis report hypothesized many small leaf primitives, but the actual Softbough GLB has two primitives; both are large (1224 and 1368 triangles).
The existing optimize command test passes with a pytest thread warning caused by CP1252 decoding an external process byte stream; it did not affect the test result.

Area-only source triangle retention is used only when no grid candidate survives or the best grid result is less than half its target. Such output is explicitly warned and remains visually unmeasured.
assumptions_made: Preserve the existing policy that each derived LOD is computed from the original LOD0 source and that strict decreasing nonempty chain validation remains the caller contract.
Separate primitives retain material boundaries because decimation continues per primitive; UV seam duplicates and distinct bone influence sets are isolated during clustering.
